propositions: During execution-phase re-review, Pass-1 flags plan-vs-code discrepancies that are actually expected outcomes of completed work (e.g., plan directs 'remove X', code has no X), causing false-positive blocks on correct tickets.
A Pass-2 veto must drop findings when execution_review=True AND a code-grounded verifier confirms current_state_satisfies_plan_goal=yes, with veto reason 'veto:plan-goal-satisfied'.

The on-target veto is cohort-restricted to CODEBASE_GROUNDED (E4/G1G2/A1/G6) to ensure only code-grounded verifiers can fire it; planning-phase reviews (execution_review=False) must preserve the finding.

The new current_state_satisfies_plan_goal binary is plan-review-only, na-default, outside GRADED_BINARY, not present on base or code-review models, and enforced deterministically in orchestrator wrapper to prevent tool-less single-turn verification from firing the veto.
Under execution_review=True, findings with answers no/insufficient/na/absent, or non-grounded cohort membership, are NOT dropped.
The orchestrator forwards the existing execution_review phase signal into kernel pass3_over_findings with cohort restriction enforcement via _restrict_on_target_veto_to_grounded.
